newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle moderately active-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle moderately active-USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderately active in Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said.

Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting moderate to good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 16,500 slaughter steers and 9,000 heifers; 81,900 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 17,800 formulated and 1,200 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 66.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 65.00. Pen mostly Select 1-3 1050 lb corrienties 63.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 66.00. Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs including heiferettes 61.00.
Confirmed - 25,500 Week Ago - None Year Ago - 47,300
Wk to Date - 81,900 Week Ago - 17,600 Year Ago - 72,100
